title: What if your expectations are the only thing holding you back?
html:
We set our own pattern for the future by the power of our belief system - a system driven by the power of expectancy.

Destiny isn't an option.

We have control over our lives, and what we expect tends to show up, for better or worse.

Positive expectancy is crucial to success because you can't move forward without it. Without positive thought, you sit in a vacuum, allowing outside forces to decide for you.

To build a positive state of mind, you must use yourimagination,creativity, anddiscipline to guide what you think, say, and do.

You become what you think about.

Every thought starts a chain reaction - self-talk that lifts or limits you, shapes your beliefs, and fuels your expectations. Those expectations, in turn, define your self-image and determine how far you'll go.

When your imagination becomes stronger than your desire, you begin tosee the outcome before it exists, and your subconscious starts working to make it real.

This Week's Motivator

Develop and practise an attitude ofpositive expectancy.

Use your imagination and creativity to picture what success looks like for you. Reinforce it daily through self-talk that builds confidence and self-worth.

Believe deeply enough, and your mind will start showing you the way.

Prompt for the Week

What are you expecting from yourself right now? Is it big enough?
